agents.name: Dr. Maya Patel
agents.backstory: Born to immigrant parents, she rose through the ranks after surviving a traumatic car accident in medical school. She now leads the ER with a reputation for calm under pressure.

routine.6-9: arrives for morning handoff, reviews charts

agents.secret: She is secretly researching a new triage protocol to secure a grant and boost her career.

agents.name: Joel Mills
agents.backstory: A former paramedic who switched to nursing after a near-fatal shift taught him the value of continuity of care. He knows every corner of the ER.

routine.6-9: prepares medication carts, assists Dr. Patel
routine.12-15: break, then returns to triage desk

agents.secret: He hoards unused medical supplies to sell on the side to fund his brother's tuition.

agents.name: Samir Li
agents.backstory: A quiet genius who grew up coding medical imaging software, he now works the ER's imaging suite, often preferring machines over people. He dreams of developing AI diagnostics.

routine.6-9: prepares imaging rooms for morning surge
routine.15-18: handles emergency imaging, fast-tracks critical cases

agents.secret: He has embedded a hidden algorithm in the imaging software that can predict patient outcomes, hoping to sell it to a biotech firm.

agents.name: Kira Johnson
agents.backstory: After a decade in corporate healthcare management, she was recruited to streamline the chaotic ER, aiming to improve efficiency and cut costs. She balances budget constraints with staff morale.

routine.6-9: meets with Dr. Patel for shift briefing
routine.12-15: lunch with department heads, audits records

agents.secret: She is under pressure from the hospital board to report a declining patient satisfaction metric, fearing potential job loss.

agents.name: Ayesha Khan
agents.backstory: A recent medical graduate from a small town, she joined the ER to gain experience after her father's death from a delayed diagnosis, fueling her determination to never miss a case. She looks up to Dr. Patel.

routine.0-6: on-call shadowing senior staff, takes notes
routine.6-9: attends morning briefing, reviews patient files
routine.9-12: assists in triage, writes initial notes
routine.12-15: spends time in charting, learns procedures
routine.15-18: participates in minor procedures under supervision
routine.18-22: debriefs with mentor, reflects on cases

agents.secret: She secretly keeps a journal of all diagnostic errors she witnesses, hoping to expose systemic flaws.
